gameName: Batman: The Movie NGPC — Stage High Scores

payloadFields.name: sourcePoints
payloadFields.format: zero-padded decimal 0..999999; earned during THIS cleared stage only

payloadFields.name: stageTicks
payloadFields.format: zero-padded decimal 1..9999999; active-display refresh ticks during this stage

scorecardFormula: For stage i, score=min(999999, sourcePoints + max(0,budget[i]-floor(stageTicks*20/1199))*100); budgetsSeconds=[480,300,60,180,720]; require stageTicks>0 and 1<=score<=999999. Rank descending by score within stage; exact scores tie. Use stageTicks as a local best tie-break only; server may retain score ties.
otherNotes: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE poly1021 initFFFF no reflection xorout0, ASCII bytes payload offsets0..31 followed by ASCII salt BATMAN65, append 4 uppercase hex digits at 32..35; URL prefix excluded. Valid stage-clear only, earned during an eligible run that started with <=3 lives; cheat unlocking disqualifies the boot. On-device rejects score0. Full QR URL has 20-character prefix and 36-character stage payload (total 56). Stages must be segregated for ranking. Overall version2 QR is separately defined in BATMAN_Leaderboard_Submission.json. Checksum validates data integrity and does not independently authenticate score legitimacy.
